name: Suppression Strafing
description: When the Command phase, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army. Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to it: it takes a Battle-shock test at -1 and, if failed, is suppressed until the start of your next turn (-1 to Hit rolls). Once per battle round.

name: Tactical Decapitation
description: When your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight. Until the end of the phase, its weapons have [PRECISION] and its attacks against Character units add 1 to the Hit roll.

name: Shock Onslaught
description: When the Fight phase, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight. Until the end of the phase, its Pile-in and Consolidation moves can be up to 6" instead of 3".

name: Auto-sense Coordination
description: When your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight. Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; until the end of the phase its weapons have it if it disembarked from a Drop Pod this turn or targets a unit within 12".

name: Blind Screen
description: When your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, target one Adeptus Astartes unit (excluding Titanic) selected as a target and one friendly Adeptus Astartes Smoke Vehicle or Drop Pod within 9" of it. Until the end of the phase, both have Stealth and Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks.

name: Onward for the Emperor
description: When the end of your opponent's Fight phase, target one Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was not set up this turn and one friendly Transport it can embark within. If the unit is wholly within 6" of it, it can embark.
